changes.now: Loki builds an army of villains to conquer Earth, and Spider-Man and S.H.I.E.L.D. keep knocking them down, until Loki raises the stakes with Venom's powers.
changes.proposed: Loki overloads villains with enchanted Nornfrost snowballs to build an army and take the throne of Asgard, and Spider-Man and S.H.I.E.L.D. keep knocking them down, until Loki overloads himself.
changes.evidence: Loki's tool is Nornfrost (enchanted snowballs) thrown at villains one by one (Doctor Octopus, Venom, the Mandarin, Abomination); Venom is just one of the overloaded villains. In the finale Loki overloads himself by eating Nornfrost snowballs, and says his plan is an army of overloaded supervillains to take the throne of Asgard, not to conquer Earth. Nothing on screen has Loki using Venom's powers.
